beforeSql:
SELECT category_id, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count
FROM support_tickets
GROUP BY category_id
ORDER BY ticket_count DESC
LIMIT 100;
afterSql:
SELECT tc.category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT st.ticket_id) AS ticket_count
FROM ticket_categories tc
LEFT JOIN support_tickets st ON st.category_id = tc.category_id
GROUP BY tc.category_id, tc.category_name
ORDER BY ticket_count DESC
LIMIT 100;

beforeSql:
-- 每月订单量及环比增长率
WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
           COUNT(*) AS order_cnt
    FROM orders
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT month,
       order_cnt,
       ROUND(
           (order_cnt - LAG(order_cnt) OVER (ORDER BY month))::numeric
           / NULLIF(LAG(order_cnt) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0),
           4
       ) AS mom_growth_rate
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 100;
afterSql:
WITH monthly_orders AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
         COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT month,
       ROUND(
         (order_count - LAG(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY month))::numeric
         / NULLIF(LAG(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0),
         4
       ) AS mom_growth_rate
FROM monthly_orders
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 100;

beforeSql:
-- 先对 order_payments 按 order_id+payment_type 去重，避免一单多笔支付放大评价记录，再关联评价求平均分
SELECT op.payment_type,
       ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_score
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT order_id, payment_type FROM order_payments) op
JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = op.order_id
GROUP BY op.payment_type
ORDER BY avg_score DESC
LIMIT 20;
afterSql:
SELECT op.payment_type,
       ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score
FROM order_payments op
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = op.order_id
JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY op.payment_type
ORDER BY avg_review_score DESC
LIMIT 10;

beforeSql:
SELECT c.campaign_id, COUNT(cu.usage_id) AS usage_count
FROM campaigns c
LEFT JOIN coupons cp ON cp.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
LEFT JOIN coupon_usages cu ON cu.coupon_id = cp.coupon_id
GROUP BY c.campaign_id
ORDER BY c.campaign_id
LIMIT 1000;
afterSql:
SELECT ca.campaign_name, COUNT(cu.usage_id) AS usage_count
FROM campaigns ca
LEFT JOIN coupons cp ON cp.campaign_id = ca.campaign_id
LEFT JOIN coupon_usages cu ON cu.coupon_id = cp.coupon_id
GROUP BY ca.campaign_id, ca.campaign_name
ORDER BY usage_count DESC
LIMIT 100;

beforeSql:
SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity, ROUND(AVG(quantity)::numeric, 2) AS avg_quantity
FROM inventory
GROUP BY warehouse_id
ORDER BY warehouse_id
LIMIT 100;
afterSql:
SELECT w.warehouse_name,
       SUM(i.quantity) AS total_quantity,
       ROUND(AVG(i.quantity)::numeric, 2) AS avg_quantity
FROM inventory i
LEFT JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id
GROUP BY i.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 100;

beforeSql:
SELECT m.level_id, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS member_count
FROM members m
JOIN user_tag_map utm ON utm.member_id = m.member_id
JOIN user_tags ut ON ut.tag_id = utm.tag_id
WHERE ut.tag_code = 'CHURN_RISK'
GROUP BY m.level_id
ORDER BY m.level_id
LIMIT 100;
afterSql:
SELECT ml.level_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ut.tag_code = 'CHURN_RISK' THEN m.member_id END) AS churn_risk_member_count
FROM member_levels ml
LEFT JOIN members m ON m.level_id = ml.level_id
LEFT JOIN user_tag_map utm ON utm.member_id = m.member_id
LEFT JOIN user_tags ut ON ut.tag_id = utm.tag_id
GROUP BY ml.level_id, ml.level_name
ORDER BY ml.level_id
LIMIT 100;

SELECT ml.level_name, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(oi.price), 0), 2) AS total_sales
FROM member_levels ml
LEFT JOIN members m ON m.level_id = ml.level_id
LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_unique_id = m.customer_unique_id
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY ml.level_id, ml.level_name
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.region_name,
       COUNT(*) AS shipment_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id) AS covered_order_count
FROM shipments s
JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id
JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = w.region_code
GROUP BY r.region_code, r.region_name
ORDER BY shipment_count DESC
LIMIT 100;

beforeSql:
SELECT c.customer_state, m.level_id, COUNT(DISTINCT st.ticket_id) AS ticket_count
FROM support_tickets st
JOIN ticket_categories tc ON tc.category_id = st.category_id
JOIN members m ON m.member_id = st.member_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_unique_id = m.customer_unique_id
WHERE tc.category_name = '物流延迟'
GROUP BY c.customer_state, m.level_id
ORDER BY ticket_count DESC, c.customer_state, m.level_id
LIMIT 20;
afterSql:
SELECT
  c.customer_state,
  ml.level_name,
  COUNT(*) AS ticket_count
FROM support_tickets st
JOIN ticket_categories tc
  ON tc.category_id = st.category_id
JOIN members m
  ON m.member_id = st.member_id
JOIN member_levels ml
  ON ml.level_id = m.level_id
JOIN orders o
  ON o.order_id = st.order_id
JOIN customers c
  ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE tc.category_name = '物流延迟'
GROUP BY
  c.customer_state,
  ml.level_id,
  ml.level_name
ORDER BY ticket_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT ref_level.level_name AS referrer_level, inv_level.level_name AS invitee_level, COUNT(*) AS referral_count, ROUND(SUM(r.reward_amount), 2) AS total_reward
FROM referrals r
LEFT JOIN members rm ON rm.member_id = r.referrer_member_id
LEFT JOIN member_levels ref_level ON ref_level.level_id = rm.level_id
LEFT JOIN members im ON im.member_id = r.invitee_member_id
LEFT JOIN member_levels inv_level ON inv_level.level_id = im.level_id
GROUP BY ref_level.level_id, ref_level.level_name, inv_level.level_id, inv_level.level_name
ORDER BY referral_count DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT w.warehouse_name,
       COALESCE(i.current_stock, 0) AS current_stock,
       COALESCE(m.outbound_90d, 0) AS outbound_90d,
       ROUND(90.0 * COALESCE(i.current_stock, 0) / NULLIF(m.outbound_90d, 0), 1) AS inventory_turnover_days
FROM warehouses w
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(quantity) AS current_stock
    FROM inventory
    GROUP BY warehouse_id
) i ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(quantity) AS outbound_90d
    FROM inventory_movements
    WHERE movement_type = '2'
      AND moved_at >= (SELECT MAX(moved_at) FROM inventory_movements) - INTERVAL '90 days'
      AND moved_at <= (SELECT MAX(moved_at) FROM inventory_movements)
    GROUP BY warehouse_id
) m ON m.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
ORDER BY w.warehouse_name
LIMIT 100;
